commands.name: gt_open
commands.description: Activate a Golden Thread project by slug.

commands.name: gt_list
commands.description: List all Golden Thread projects in the vault.

commands.name: gt_create
commands.description: Create a new Golden Thread project.

commands.name: gt_work
commands.description: Append a timestamped progress entry to the active project's log.

commands.description: Record an Architecture Decision Record for the active project.

commands.description: Close the active Golden Thread session/project claim.

commands.description: Audit the vault for structural problems.

commands.description: One report for the whole install and vault.

commands.description: View or change Golden Thread settings.

commands.description: Complete a project, task, or handoff.

commands.description: Empty the inbox and route captured items into projects.

commands.description: Scan code against language definitions in effect.

commands.description: Commit once checks pass and a test receipt covers staged files.
